items.title: 52986_Lawrence Brown oral history interview
items.q: She is Mrs. Elaine Jenkins... And so I worked with her, helped her set up this company called One America.

ctx.x: So, after you left Duke in 1970, what did you do then?

I went to Washington, D. C. where a cousin of mine has a consultant firm, and stayed there for a while. Then I went back to Detroit and stayed a while. I had lived in Detroit for a couple of years. And I didn't care much for that any more. So, I finally came back to Washington, D. C. and worked with my cousin in this firm. The firm is called One America. She is Mrs. Elaine Jenkins, who is quite prominent in the Republican field.

And so I worked with her, helped her set up this company called One America. And it finally got going pretty good, and while I was in this job with this company, I got an appointment to the Kennedy Center as the consultant for -- in relations to the public -- Kennedy Center.
